headlines.title: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
headlines.description: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.

headlines.title: Key inflation reports will reveal read on U.S. economy ahead of midterms
headlines.description: Two key reports on consumer and producer pricing will provide a final read on the U.S. economy before the midterms. NBC News’ Allie Canal details what to watch as the reports are released.

headlines.title: RJ Mitte, actor best known for playing Walter White Jr. on ‘Breaking Bad,’ dies at 34
headlines.description: Mitte played the son of the teacher-turned-meth producer in the hit series.

headlines.title: Omar’s home searched as part of federal criminal investigation
headlines.description: Federal agents carried out a search warrant on Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar’s home in Washington as part of a federal criminal investigation. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: One dead at Six Flags park in Georgia
headlines.description: An emergency on the Goliath roller coaster at the Six Flags outside Atlanta led to evacuations from the ride and passengers having to climb a steep descent. Authorities say one person was killed at the park and several others injured. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler reports.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh Airport Hit With 2 Strikes in 2 Days
headlines.description: Videos show the moments Riyadh Airport, the main airport in Saudi Arabia, was hit in a deadly attack on Saturday and then again on Sunday, killing more than a dozen including one American. Now questions swirl about whether the United States will join airstrikes against the Iranian-backed Houthi militants responsible for the attacks, which would widen the U.S.-Iran conflict just weeks before the midterm elections. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Shane Gillis’ ‘SNL’ monologue slammed as sexist for comments about women
headlines.description: The comedian drew criticism online after he said women at the gym “just dress like whores now.”

headlines.title: Selma Blair in custody after allegedly assaulting flight attendants
headlines.description: Law enforcement sources describe a series of assaults on two flight attendants, a Port Authority officer and a hospital nurse. Blair’s representatives say she experienced a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct. NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: Judge tears into Trump administration for felling trees on D.C. golf course the president wants to remake
headlines.description: “I’m furious,” U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes told a Justice Department lawyer. “I trusted you all not to do precisely what you have done.”

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Florida Republican running for re-election snags presidential endorsement — from Colombia
headlines.description: Rep. María Elvira Salazar has received political support from right-wing stalwarts overseas as she finds herself on the outs with President Donald Trump.
